title: Guru Gobind Singh's Encounter with Banda Singh Bahadur

blocks.text: On arrival the Guru sees a moving carriage and an elaborately arranged resting place, signs of the theatrical world Banda has built around himself and his followers.
The meeting scene sharpens immediately: the Guru mounts the prepared couch, Banda’s people try to move or lift it in anger, and the whole arrangement turns uncanny under the Guru’s presence.
What was meant to display Banda’s authority instead becomes the first visible crack in it, as the confrontation opens under wonder, frustration, and failed control.
